en.headline: Chinalco sets up corporate treasury centre in Hong Kong
en.dek: The state-owned aluminium giant will use the new entity to manage offshore funds, financing and risk, highlighting the city’s role as a hub.
body: Aluminum Corporation of China, known as Chinalco, has established a corporate treasury centre in Hong Kong to manage the group’s offshore funds, Invest Hong Kong announced on Friday.

The new entity, Chinalco Treasury Management Co Ltd, will centrally manage the group’s offshore funds and handle offshore financing, exchange rate and interest rate risk management, as well as integrated financial services.

Director-General of Investment Promotion Alpha Lau said the move demonstrated Hong Kong’s strengths as the first port of call for mainland firms going global and as a hub for corporate treasury centres. She noted that as the world’s largest offshore renminbi hub, the city could provide cross-border renminbi settlement, multi-currency fund management and risk hedging capabilities.

Chinalco Chief Financial Officer Wang Xin said Hong Kong’s foreign exchange market, the fourth largest in the world, together with its channels for renminbi financing and trade settlement and its connection to the mainland, would help the group manage its global funds more efficiently. The company plans to build a fully functional offshore fund management platform.

zh.headline: 中鋁集團在港設立企業財資中心
zh.dek: 這家國有鋁業巨頭將透過新實體管理離岸資金、融資及風險，突顯香港作為財資中心樞紐的角色。
body: 投資推廣署周五宣布，中國鋁業集團有限公司（中鋁集團）在港設立企業財資中心，負責管理集團的離岸資金。
新成立的中鋁集團財資管理有限公司將集中管理集團離岸資金，並處理離岸融資、匯率及利率風險管理，以及綜合金融服務。
投資推廣署署長劉凱旋表示，此舉展示香港作為內地企業「出海」首站及企業財資中心樞紐的優勢。她指出，香港作為全球最大離岸人民幣樞紐，可提供人民幣跨境結算、多幣種資金管理及風險對沖能力。
中鋁集團總會計師王欣說，香港外匯市場規模位列全球第四，加上人民幣融資及貿易結算渠道完善，以及背靠內地的獨特優勢，有助集團更高效地管理全球資金。公司計劃構建功能完備的離岸資金管理平台。
